name: biai-crm
description: BIAI admissions CRM (React client, Node.js API, PostgreSQL) and a separate channel simulator website.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,crm,simulator -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w simulator"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w simulator
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w simulator
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.dev:crm: concurrently -k -n server,crm -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.bundle: npm run build -w client && npm run bundle -w server
